validation.notes: Repaired two production modules and exercised them together in one VM module graph built with createGraph from .prale-eval/subject.mjs: 'packages/coding-agent/src/migrations.ts' (migrateSessionsFromAgentRoot) and 'packages/coding-agent/src/core/session-manager.ts' (loadEntriesFromFile, SessionManager.open), with boundary fakes for ./config.ts (getAgentDir, getBinDir, getSessionsDir, APP_NAME, CONFIG_DIR_NAME), ./core/keybindings.ts, ./utils/text.ts, ../utils/paths.ts, chalk, and the pi-ai/messages factories. Fix 1 (migrations.ts): the unconditional renameSync onto an existing destination is now guarded by existsSync(newPath) + continue, so existing destination bytes win, the legacy source file stays in place (both sides of the collision preserved) and the remaining files in the loop still migrate. Fix 2 (session-manager.ts loadEntriesFromFile): the header guard's '&&' became '||' so a header that is not a session record or lacks a string id is rejected before the missing-final-newline repair, leaving the file byte-identical, matching parseSessionHeaderCandidate()/readSessionHeader() used by discovery; valid headers still load and valid unterminated final records (well-formed or malformed tail) plus header-only files are still newline-terminated. Observed assertions: destination bytes unchanged; source bytes unchanged; second legacy file moved to sessions/--tmp-prale-project-b--/other.jsonl; both preserved files load via loadEntriesFromFile and SessionManager.open with their own ids (destination-session vs source-session); invalid-header files return zero entries and are unmodified, and SessionManager.open throws 'Session file is not a valid pi session' without writing; valid unterminated files return all entries and gain the trailing newline. Regression detection verified per file: restoring only session-manager.ts to the '&&' baseline fails with AssertionError 'invalid header must be rejected (header without id)'; restoring only migrations.ts to the unguarded rename baseline fails with AssertionError 'collision must not overwrite existing destination bytes'; both are plain uncaught assertions, not crashes or import errors. No real time, randomness, network or external services are used; module evaluation order is controlled by awaiting graph.module() promises and temp inputs live under .prale-eval/tmp, removed before and after the run. Limitation: the repository's vitest suite could not be run because node_modules is not installed in this workspace and dependency installation is disallowed, so validation evidence is the standalone vm-module regression script only.
